_doc: Plan of one video. Written by tools/projet.py (cameras, sync, framing) then by Claude (keep, inserts, sfx) and tools/music_plan.py (music). Times are seconds of the voice camera's rush ; an anchor "mot@12.3" is the spoken word nearest 12.3 s (punctuation and apostrophes ignored), "src:12.34" an exact rush time.
title: Mon titre de vidéo
_doc_cameras: One phone : cameras ["A"], voice_cam "A", offsets {"A": 0}, framings ["A", "At", "Att"]. faces = centre of the face (0..1) for the tight crops.
_doc_lock: From that rush time on, one framing only (the goodbye seen face on). Optional.
whisper_prompt: les noms propres et le jargon de la vidéo
_doc_inserts: kind : keyword (style simple or gras, from the style), icon, caption, nametag (over the face) ; bullets, diamonds, doc, term, still, wall, logo, ytcard, tokens, alert, scene (full screen). See the top of prompteur_blocks.py. files = images copied next to the insert. chapter : true marks a chapter card (the music may change there if the style says so).
_doc_music: plan.music is written by tools/music_plan.py from the look's palette : do not write it by hand.
_doc_style: look = the creator's style (looks/<name>/look.json). tools/projet.py copies its framing and cut values here ; the values below are an imaginary creator's, not a recommendation.
